title: When the Church is Under Fire: Standing Firm in the Power of the Holy
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he delivers a powerful message about the spiritual attack on the church and the importance of living a life empowered by the Holy Ghost. Drawing from 2 Corinthians 9:6, Pastor Chris encourages believers to stand strong in the face of persecution and to trust in God's provision for His people. This sermon is a timely reminder of the church's need to stand united and empowered by the Spirit in the midst of opposition.
